title: Variables and Data Types
goal: Har C data type, sizeof, scope/lifetime, storage classes, conversion aur overflow ko practically samajhna.
prereqs: Module 1-2: program likhna aur compile karna
definition: Variable memory ka named location hai jiska type batata hai kitni bytes chahiye aur unhe kaise interpret karna hai. C ke fundamental types char, int, float, double aur void hain; unke short/long/signed/unsigned variants derived aur user-defined types ke saath milte hain.
explain: C statically typed hai: type compile time par fix hota hai aur variable ka size bhi. int typically 4 bytes, char 1 byte, double 8 bytes — exact size platform par depend karta hai, isliye sizeof use karo.
Declaration memory reserve karti hai, initialization pehli value deti hai. Local variable uninitialized ho to uska value indeterminate hota hai — padhna undefined behaviour hai.
Scope batata hai naam kahan dikhega; lifetime batata hai memory kab tak zinda rahegi. Local block ke andar, global poore file me, static lifetime program ke end tak.
Type conversion implicit (compiler) ya explicit (cast) hoti hai. Chhoti type me bada value daalne par truncation hota hai; signed overflow undefined behaviour hai — unsigned wrap karta hai.
analogy: Variable ek dabba hai jiska label naam hai aur shape type. int ka dabba 4-byte ka hai, char ka 1-byte. Galat shape me zyada saaman thoosoge to overflow ho jaayega.
why: 90% C bugs type ke galat assumption se aate hain: int overflow, float precision, unsigned underflow, uninitialized read. Inhe samajhna pointers aur memory ka base hai.

syntax.note: Suffixes: u unsigned, L long, LL long long, f float.
sizeof size_t deta hai, isliye %zu. limits.h me har type ki limits hain.
Cast intention clear karta hai; unsigned wrap defined hai, signed overflow nahi.

topics.title: Keywords aur identifiers
topics.body: C17 me 32 keywords (int, return, if, ...). Identifier letters, digits aur underscore se banta hai, digit se shuru nahi hota, case-sensitive hai. Meaningful naam likho: total_marks, na ki tm.

topics.title: Fundamental types
topics.body: char (1 byte, character/boolean-ish), int (usually 4), float (4, ~7 digits), double (8, ~15 digits), void (no value). short/long/long long size modifiers; signed/unsigned range badalte hain.

topics.title: sizeof aur limits
topics.body: sizeof operator bytes deta hai, compile time par. <limits.h> INT_MAX/INT_MIN/CHAR_BIT deta hai, <float.h> DBL_EPSILON/FLT_MAX. Portable code sizeof par likho, hardcoded 4 par nahi.

topics.title: Scope, lifetime, storage classes
topics.body: auto (default local, block lifetime), static (local: lifetime poore program ki, value retain; file-scope: internal linkage), extern (definition kahin aur hai), register (compiler ko hint, address nahi le sakte). Global variables zero-initialized hoti hain, locals nahi.

topics.title: Conversion, overflow, precision
topics.body: Integer promotion chhote types ko int me badalti hai. Float→int truncate karta hai. Signed overflow UB hai (compiler optimize kar sakta hai). 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 false hota hai — binary floating point exact nahi hai. const/volatile/restrict qualifiers intent batate hain.

examples.title: Types aur sizeof
lines: char '%c', int '%d', float '%.1f', double '%.3f' se print hote hain.
sizeof variable par bhi chalta hai.
Sizes platform par depend karte hain — ye common 64-bit values hain.

examples.title: Casting aur overflow
lines: (int)99.99 truncate karke 99 deta hai, round nahi.
unsigned char 250 + 10 = 260 mod 256 = 4; unsigned wrap defined hai.

visual.title: Memory sketch (typical 64-bit)
rows: Padding ho sakti hai — struct me alignment ke liye gaps aate hain.

mistakes.why: Uninitialized local ka value indeterminate hota hai; read karna UB.
Unsigned arithmetic wrap hoti hai, comparison hamesha true ho sakta hai.
Binary floating point exact nahi hota; epsilon se compare karo.

debug.brief: Average galat aa raha hai kyunki integer division ho raha hai. Fix karo.
hints: a / b ka type kya hai?

best: Variables ko declare karte hi initialize karo
sizeof se size lo, hardcode mat karo
Money ke liye double/float ki jagah integer paise ya decimal library

mcqs.explain: Signed overflow UB hai; unsigned wrap defined hai.
Static storage duration wale objects zero-initialized hote hain.

interview.q: float aur double me kya chuno?
interview.a: float 4 bytes ~7 significant digits, double 8 bytes ~15. Default double lo; float sirf memory-critical arrays me jab precision kaafi ho.
Lifetime poore program ki hoti hai par scope block tak seemit; function calls ke beech value retain hoti hai (e.g. call counter). Thread-safe nahi.
interview.followUp: static global ka matlab? — internal linkage, sirf usi translation unit me dikhta hai.

interview.a: Jab aap jaan-bujh kar conversion chahte ho (double→int truncation, void*→typed pointer) ya warning suppress karni ho. Implicit conversion par bharosa mat karo.
interview.followUp: Casting pointer ka risk? — galat type par dereference UB.
